dct_description_sm: The objectives of this project were: (1) to complete a research gap analysis assessment for the Great Bear Lake Watershed's aquatic ecosystems; (2) to integrate scientific and traditional knowledge to build water monitoring education in Dline; and (3) to develop water monitoring protocols for the potential impacts of climate change on Great Bear Lake, thus increasing the community's future capacity to adapt to climate change impacts.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Adaptation
dct_title_s: Planning for Climate Change Impacts on the Aquatic Ecosystems of Great Bear Lake and its Watershed
